annotations.title: Average new deposit and consumer loan rates in Polish banks (NBP MIR)

description: Use for the average rate on new deposits in Polish banks by maturity, how much more the best deposits pay than the bank average, and the average rate and APRC of new consumer loans. With view=history: the average deposit rate since 2005 (last 10 or 20 years, historical data) and in how many years an average deposit beat inflation. For offers of single banks, use get_bank_rates. NBP interest rate statistics (MIR) for new household business in PLN: average rate on new term deposits (all maturities and by original maturity) with the value and share of new deposits by maturity, and the average rate and APRC (RRSO) of new consumer loans. With finwire Deposit Choice Premium (finwire_deposit_choice_premium): how much more the finwire deposit index (5 best 3-month deposits) pays than the average new 1-3 month deposit, in pp and in PLN per year on PLN 10,000 after tax, plus a current estimate. With view=history: the average deposit rate monthly since 2005 by maturity, yearly averages against annual average CPI (GUS) and finwire Real Average Deposit Rate (finwire_real_avg_deposit_rate): the real result of an average deposit year by year before and after tax and in how many years it beat inflation. Market averages, not an offer. Informational data, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months (view latest, default 12) or past years (view history, default all) in the summary.

view.description: latest (default): latest month, premium and consumer loans; history: average deposit rate since 2005, yearly real result against inflation.
